query: Civiqs daily tracker Trump net approval latest

results.content:
According to Civiqs, last updated August 12, Trump's net approval in New Jersey stood at -35%.

New Jersey tilts unfavorable overall. About 65% of New Jersey residents polled currently disapprove of the president's performance.About 30% approve and another 5% did not choose either.

Education: Respondents across all education levels disapprove of Trump’s job performance, with postgraduate at 78%, college graduate at 67% and non-college graduate at 60%.

results.title: Trump’s Approval Rating Is Underwater in 11 States He Won Comfortably

results.content:
Nationally, 35 percent of voters approve of Trump's job performance while 59 percent disapprove as of August 19, leaving him significantly underwater with a net approval rating of -24, according to Civiqs' rolling online tracking poll of registered voters. The survey has garnered 124,759 responses since January 20, 2025, when Trump was inaugurated for a second term. [...] According to the Civiqs poll, Trump has the highest net approval rating in Wyoming, where 56 percent of voters approve of his performance and 35 disapprove—giving him a net approval rating of +22 when rounding up.
